Overview

What this project is and where to read next.

On this page
  • What to read when
  • About these docs

style-guide-zoo applies a collection of prose style guides — each written as a Claude system prompt — to a shared corpus of passages, several runs each, and publishes the outputs side by side with the complete provenance of every generation. All generation happens locally through the Claude Code CLI and is committed; nothing is generated in CI or in the browser.

The project is built and working. The full matrix is ten guides × nine passages × five runs = 450 committed records, every cell populated, no failures. The repository is still private pending a visual check of the site; see the Backlog.

About these docs

Markdown in docs/ is the source. docs/site/ and docs/roadmap.md are generated by uv run scripts/pmdocs.py build — the pre-commit hook does this for you — and are never edited by hand. docs/pmdocs.toml maps source files to the pages that describe them. Ad-hoc ideas go in TODO.md at the repository root; they are triaged into the backlog.

Note that two directories are called "site" and they are unrelated: site/ at the root is the published style-guide-zoo application that .github/workflows/pages.yml deploys, while docs/site/ is this documentation rendered to HTML.
